description: Western Disturbance Forecast Reliability Specialist diagnosing separate arrival timing, trough location, precipitation amount, spatial displacement, duration, and rain/snow partition failure modes across Western Himalayan high-altitude, foothill, and Indo-Gangetic plain terrain regimes.

invariants.decomposed_failure_modes: Arrival timing, trough location, precipitation amount, spatial displacement, duration, and rain/snow partition are evaluated separately; never collapsed into an opaque single score.
invariants.anti_leakage: Uses strictly issue-time features available at t0; NCMRWF 500-hPa analyses and IMD gridded precipitation/snow observations sealed with 24h verification latency.
invariants.terrain_conditioned_validation: Performance certified across Western Himalayan High-Altitude (>2500m), Foothill/Sub-Himalayan (500-2500m), and Indo-Gangetic Plains (<500m) regimes.
invariants.rain_snow_null_safety: Rain/snow phase partition error is strictly null unless high-altitude ground observations and freezing level/surface temperature are available.
